audience: Adult crocheters making seasonal table décor
Crocheters who enjoy modern autumn styling

patterns.name: Maple Leaf Placemat
patterns.approx_size: about 38 cm wide by 35 cm long
patterns.construction: Worked flat from a central stem area, with shaped lobes and a neat edging worked around the outer leaf.
patterns.summary: A generously sized, textured maple-leaf placemat that creates the focal layer of an autumn place setting.

patterns.name: Oak Leaf Appliqué
patterns.construction: Worked flat along a foundation chain with rounded oak-leaf lobes, a central vein and a short stem.
patterns.summary: A slim oak-leaf motif for stitching onto the runner or layering across placemats, pockets and table displays.

patterns.name: Beech Leaf Coaster
patterns.construction: Worked flat from a central chain with softly pointed sides, a defined vein and a compact stem.
patterns.summary: A small beech-leaf coaster with a smooth pointed silhouette, sized for mugs, small glasses or candle holders.

patterns.name: Acorn Napkin Ring
patterns.approx_size: about 6 cm across with 5 cm acorn
patterns.construction: A narrow ring is worked in the round, with a separate textured acorn cap and acorn body sewn together and attached.
patterns.summary: A reusable crochet napkin ring decorated with one small textured acorn for a warm autumnal place-setting accent.

patterns.name: Falling Leaves Table Runner
patterns.approx_size: about 100 cm long by 28 cm wide
patterns.construction: Worked flat in textured rows with tapered ends and spaced eyelet channels for positioning sewn-on leaf appliqués.
patterns.summary: A long, lightly textured table runner with tapered ends, designed as the grounding centrepiece for layered leaf appliqués.

patterns.name: Chestnut Cutlery Pocket
patterns.approx_size: about 10 cm wide by 18 cm long
patterns.construction: A simple rectangle is worked flat, folded into a pocket and seamed along the sides, with a curved chestnut-inspired flap.
patterns.summary: A compact chestnut-shaped cutlery pocket for holding a fork, knife and spoon beside each autumn place setting.

combinations.title: Autumn Table Styling Ideas
combinations.intro: Use terracotta, ochre, moss, mulberry, warm cream and oatmeal shades across the pieces, allowing soft stone neutrals to keep the table setting refined.

items.name: Layered Maple Place Setting
notes: Place the coaster near the upper leaf lobes and tuck the napkin ring through a folded linen napkin.
Use related earth tones rather than matching every item exactly.

items.name: Falling Leaves Centre Runner
notes: Sew the oak leaves along the runner's eyelet channels, varying their direction for a scattered-leaf effect.
Place the maple placemat at one end as a focal serving mat, joining the focal piece visually with the foliage-covered runner.

items.name: Four-Place Harvest Table
notes: Choose two or three repeating yarn colours for an abundant but calm coordinated table.
